Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the invoice.

Short answer: we can help but need a couple of items to move forward.

What we need from Globex:
- A copy of the payment advice / bank trace showing the EUR 25.00 deduction and the final credited amount to Redwood.
- Beneficiary bank details you used (sending bank name + account, sending reference).

Operational options we can offer (please indicate preference):
1) Issue a credit note for the EUR 25.00 (so you show a credit and reclaim VAT on the corrected net). This is the fastest approach from our side.
2) Issue a corrected invoice that gross-ups the original amount to explicitly show the fee allocation. Note: grossing-up changes tax reporting on our side and will require approval from Finance.

Our standard policy is that intermediary bank charges are borne by the beneficiary unless Sender-Cover was agreed in advance. That said, for longstanding partners we will evaluate absorbing small deductions case-by-case. If you prefer option (2) please confirm and provide the payment trace.

I’ve looped in Laura (finance) and Marissa (billing ops) to confirm whether we can issue a grossed-up invoice for VAT reclaim or whether a credit note is the preferred fixed approach.
